reviewItem.question: Does "Service connections that use `Direct-Server-Return` and were established prior to Cilium v1.13.3 will be disrupted, and need to be re-established" mean a change to migration:cilium|name=dsr-service-connections-reestablish (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: Service connections using Direct-Server-Return that were established before Cilium v1.13.3 will be disrupted on upgrade and must be re-established.
